newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon Byblos bank approves $300 mln EuroCDs.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon Byblos bank approves $300 mln EuroCDs.

text.p: BEIRUT, March 20 (reuter) - Shareholders in Lebanon's Byblos Bank approved on Thursday a three-year $300 million EuroCD programme and said the first $100 million tranche would be issued in May.

The notes will have five-year maturities and carry between 2.2 and 2.4 percent interest plus the interest on U.S. treasury bonds, Byblos Assistant general manager Moussa Makssoud told Reuters after the general assembly held at noon.
